{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue for thousands separators
print("First 5 revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders
print("Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check status
print("Unique values in status:", df['status'].unique())"}
